biggest_catch: Both $25 bonuses are paid only after your friend opens a new checking account AND establishes direct deposit — and gig-economy/self-employment income and digital-wallet transfers don't count as qualifying direct deposit.
catches: New member must open a membership AND a new checking account with direct deposit for both parties to receive $25; existing City & County checking accounts do not qualify.
Direct deposit must be established within 6 months of account opening; the $25 bonus is deposited into each account within 30 days of the direct deposit.
Qualifying direct deposit excludes digital wallet transfers and income from self-employment or IRS-classified gig-economy jobs.
Referral form or promo code RAF must be referenced at account application; referring member must be in good standing.
No annual cap on the referrer's bonuses is stated on the official page; program details subject to change; bonuses may be reported to the IRS.

steps: Complete the Refer a Friend Form on cccu.com.
Give the form to your friend.
Your friend opens a new CCCU membership and checking account with direct deposit (use promo code RAF when opening online).
Direct deposit must be established within 6 months of account opening (gig-economy/self-employment income and digital-wallet transfers excluded).
You and your friend each receive $25, deposited within 30 days of the direct deposit.
